scripts.start: adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 2>/dev/null || true && expo start
scripts.start:dev: adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 2>/dev/null || true && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 2>/dev/null || true && EXPO_PUBLIC_ENV=dev expo start --localhost
scripts.android:legacy: (adb wait-for-device && adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 &) && expo start --android
scripts.fix: adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && echo 'Tuneis restaurados!'
scripts.stop: kill $(cat /tmp/bff_server.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && echo 'BFF parado' || echo 'BFF nao estava a correr'
